mapper.sql: FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt C LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = C.ChnlCode LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal T ON T.ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltType' AND T.ConstrVal = C.CustConsltType LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal R ON R.ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltReasonType' AND R.ConstrVal = C.CustConsltReasonType LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal M ON M.ConstrCode = 'cConsltMediaType' AND M.ConstrVal = C.ConsltMediaType LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = CAST(C.OrderNo AS UNSIGNED) AND OP.OrderProdNo = CAST(C.OrderProdNo AS UNSIGNED)

where.if: AND C.AnswrCntnts IS NOT NULL AND C.AnswrCntnts <> ''

AND (REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(C.CustMobileNo, ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.phone}, '%') OR REPLACE(REPLACE(IFNULL(C.CustPhoneNo, ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.phone}, '%'))
AND (C.ConsltTitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR C.ConsltCntnts LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND C.ConsltDate >= #{q.start} AND C.ConsltDate < ADDDATE(#{q.end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select:
SELECT C.CustConsltNo, C.CustConsltType, T.ConstrValDesc AS CustConsltTypeName, C.CustConsltReasonType, R.ConstrValDesc AS CustConsltReasonTypeName, C.ConsltMediaType, M.ConstrValDesc AS ConsltMediaTypeName, C.CustId, C.CustName, C.CustEmail, C.CustPhoneNo, C.CustMobileNo, C.ConsltTitle, C.ConsltCntnts, CAST(C.ConsltDate AS CHAR) AS ConsltDate, C.MngrId, C.MngrName, C.AnswrTitle, C.AnswrCntnts, CAST(C.AnswrDate AS CHAR) AS AnswrDate, C.OrderNo, C.OrderProdNo, C.ProdCode, OP.ProdName AS ProdName, C.ItemName, C.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName AS ChnlName, (CASE WHEN C.AnswrCntnts IS NOT NULL AND C.AnswrCntnts <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Answered
ORDER BY C.CustConsltNo DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
